results.name: Alternating Plank Lunge
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Step your right foot forward outside your right hand, bringing your body into a low lunge position.
Return your right foot to the plank position.
Step your left foot forward outside your left hand, bringing your body into a low lunge position. Return your left foot to the plank position. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and proper alignment.
Ensure your front knee is aligned with your ankle and does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Alternating Plank Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Triceps.

results.name: Alternating Toe Tap
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight on the floor and your arms resting by your sides.
Simultaneously lift your right leg and left arm towards the ceiling, trying to touch your toe with your hand.
Lower your right leg and left arm back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg and right arm, lifting them towards the ceiling and trying to touch your toe with your hand. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Keep your legs straight and avoid bending your knees to ensure proper form.
results.description: Alternating Toe Tap is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Shoulders.

results.name: Arm Rotation Knee Lift
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight and feet shoulder-width apart.
Fold your arms at your sides and make fists with your hands near your chest.
Raise your right knee while rotating your torso to the left side and back to the right side.
Return to the initial position and repeat by raising your other knee.
tips: Focus on lifting your knee high to fully engage your hip flexors.
Use your oblique muscles to initiate the twist, enhancing the rotational movement.
Maintain an even pace to ensure both sides of your body are working evenly.
results.description: Arm Rotation Knee Lift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Shoulders.

results.name: Assisted Sit Ups
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor, with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, close together. Have your partner hold your feet, holding them securely for stability.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position with control. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you lift your upper body towards your knees and inhale as you lower it back down.
Perform the exercise slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and effectiveness.
Keep your elbows out to the sides and avoid pulling on your neck with your hands.
results.description: Assisted Sit Ups is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Band Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat and secure a resistance band around both feet. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outward, and keep your legs extended straight.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the floor. Bend your right knee towards your chest while simultaneously twisting your torso to bring your left elbow towards your right knee.
Switch sides by bending your left knee towards your chest while bringing your right elbow towards your left knee, performing a pedaling motion.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; use your abs to lift and twist your torso.
Ensure the resistance band is securely placed around your feet and on the equipment to avoid slipping.
Maintain a steady rhythm and focus on controlled movements rather than speed.
results.description: Band Bicycle Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Barbell Landmine Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the end of the landmine barbell at your side with your arm straight and your core engaged.
Slowly bend your torso toward the barbell while keeping your hips still and your chest facing forward.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement without twisting your shoulders or hips.
Squeeze your obliques to return to the starting position, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
tips: Keep your working arm straight without shrugging your shoulder.
Keep your knees slightly bent to improve balance and stability.
Keep your torso facing forward throughout the movement. Move only through your waist and avoid rotating your shoulders or hips.
Exhale as you return to the upright position and inhale as you bend sideways.
results.description: Barbell Landmine Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Back, Forearms.

results.name: Barbell Rollout
instructions: Begin by kneeling on a mat with a barbell placed in front of you. Grip the barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands shoulder-width apart.
Slowly roll the barbell forward, extending your arms and allowing your body to move forward.
Roll out as far as you can while maintaining control and a neutral spine. Your arms should be fully extended, and your body should be in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Engage your core and use your abdominal muscles to pull the barbell back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a strong core throughout the movement to stabilize your spine and prevent injury.
Keep your back flat and avoid letting your hips sag to ensure proper form.
Control the rolling motion to maximize muscle engagement and prevent strain.
results.description: Barbell Rollout is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

results.name: Barbell Seated Twist on Exercise Ball
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the floor, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Begin by rotating your torso to the right, keeping your hips and lower body stationary. Rotate until you feel a stretch in your obliques.
Reverse the movement, rotating your torso to the left, again keeping your hips and lower body stationary.
Repeat the rotation to both sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Engage your core muscles to stabilize your spine and maintain proper form.
Maintain an upright posture to avoid straining your lower back.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
results.description: Barbell Seated Twist on Exercise Ball is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Seated Twist
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Begin by rotating your torso to the right, keeping your hips and lower body stationary. Rotate until you feel a stretch in your obliques.
Reverse the movement, rotating your torso to the left, again keeping your hips and lower body stationary.
Repeat the rotation to both sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Engage your core muscles to stabilize your spine and maintain proper form.
Maintain an upright posture to avoid straining your lower back.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
results.description: Barbell Seated Twist is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Side Bends
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Lean to the right side by bending at the waist, lowering your torso as far as is comfortable.
Return to the starting position by engaging your oblique muscles and straightening your torso.
Repeat the movement to the left side. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid twisting your torso during the movement to focus on the side bend.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you bend to each side and inhaling as you return to the center.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
results.description: Barbell Side Bends is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.
